messages:
alex_sales: Hey team — Aurelius Health pushed back RFI v2 this morning. They want an updated capability matrix, redacted sample logs, and a POC pricing breakdown. I uploaded the latest sheet here: https://drive.redwood.com/aurelius/RFI_v2.xlsx. Who can own which sections? /cc @rachel_se @ian_sec

rachel_se: I'll take the infra/security rows + the quantization/compatibility notes. Can someone confirm current perf numbers for s1-small (target p50 < 300ms)?

ian_sec: I'll own the security questionnaire (SOC2, KMS/HSM, data residency). Need confirmation on on-prem packaging details and whether we have a FedRAMP statement to include. Assigning @matt_pm for customer-specific environment and licensing answers.

matt_pm: Aurelius specifically asked for VPC peering + customer-managed KMS. We support both for Dedicated and Private. On-prem requires a licensed bundle + onsite installer; I'll link the packaging options. For POC pricing, they asked for a 2-week Dedicated small trial — what number should we quote for day rate?

alex_sales: Sales asked for a ballpark: 2-week Dedicated small + 5k tokens/day baseline. My rough calc was ~$12k for the period but need finance sign-off. Also asked: are audit logs exportable for Dedicated and Private?

rachel_se: Perf quick paste (will put full table in the sheet):
```
{"model":"RedPose-13B-quant","profile":"s1-small","p50_ms":220,"p99_ms":420,"test_seq_len":512}
```
I'll drop this into the RFI sheet under "Performance" and add a note about variability with batch size and KV cache hit rate.

ian_sec: Audit logs: yes — we support S3 export and syslog forwarding for both Dedicated and Private. Retention and format details will be listed in the questionnaire response. For HSM: we support BYOK via customer KMS integrations; for air-gapped/on-prem we have an offline key import flow (docs link to follow).

alex_sales: Legal also asked about POC terms: SCCs/DPA and a short POC SOW. @matt_pm can you drop the standard POC SOW link into the sheet and mark any clauses that need legal review?

matt_pm: POC SOW uploaded: https://company.share/aurelius/poc-sow.pdf. I'll route the licensing/pricing ask to finance for approval — aim to have a signed POC quote by EOD tomorrow.

rfi-bot: Reminder: final capability matrix & questionnaire draft due by Fri 18:00 PST to meet Aurelius procurement window.

alex_sales: Thanks — can we aim for a draft matrix + security answers by Thu 12:00 so I can prep for a Thurs PM sync with Aurelius? :thumbsup:

rachel_se: Ack. I'll update the sheet and add a "limitations" row that calls out quantization tradeoffs and recommended max sequence length for p95/latency-sensitive routes.

ian_sec: Adding answers to Section 3 & 7 now, will include a sample IAM policy and a screenshot of the KMS console integration for reference.

alex_sales: Perfect. If anyone hits blockers ping me directly and I'll escalate to solutions engineering.
